faq.title: Before you generate a checklist
faq.description: The checklist is a preparation aid, not an official visa decision or guarantee.

official.question: Is this an official embassy checklist?
official.answer: No. It is an independent preparation guide. Always verify the final document list, fees, appointment flow, and submission rules with the relevant official embassy, consulate, government, VFS, TLS, or BLS source.

openai.question: How is the checklist generated?
openai.answer: The website uses stored Sanity rules and sources, then OpenAI can format or research a structured checklist when configured.

sources.question: Can requirements change?
sources.answer: Yes. Schengen rules and provider instructions can change, so the result includes reminders to check official sources before booking, paying, or submitting documents.

free.question: Does the website guarantee visa approval?
free.answer: No. A checklist can help preparation, but only the relevant authority can assess and decide a visa application.
